morbi.headline: Mixed margin pressures for Morbi ceramics as energy costs fluctuate amid weak exports.
what_changed: Industrial propane gas prices increased by ₹3 to ₹104/kg while natural gas prices received a ₹5 discount.
Ceramic exports to the Gulf resumed, though the general export outlook remains depressed.
Local manufacturers raised unresolved power, water, and infrastructure issues with state ministers.
stress_signals: Industrial propane gas hiked by ₹3 to ₹104/kg, inflating production costs [9e8c549b7c05]
Persistent infrastructural issues including power supply and water availability [8b17a473b62a]
Overall export demand for Morbi ceramic shipments remains weak despite Gulf trade resuming [c2b4a2f5422a]
Suspicious imported coal stock found in a closed ceramic factory in Rafaleshwar GIDC [f675c060fa53]
improvement_signals: Natural gas prices reduced by ₹5 from ₹82 following ministerial intervention [279312659941]
Kajaria Ceramics reported Q2 2026 sales and profit beats and invested ₹1.21 Cr in Sunsure Solar [83abd2d67eca, a2787358932e]
Ceramic export shipments to Gulf destinations have resumed [c2b4a2f5422a]
what_to_watch: Margin impact on unorganized tile units balancing higher propane costs against natural gas discounts.
Order book strength and receivables tracking for units dependent on Gulf export corridors.
Operational continuity and power stability metrics following ministerial representations.

surat.headline: Surat faces severe textile payment delays and diamond layoffs despite minor recovery efforts.
what_changed: Textile payment cycles stretched past 200 days, triggering trade protests and severe cash-flow friction between weavers and traders.
Diamond sector shows acute distress with widespread job losses and US export order slumps, despite isolated pre-Diwali demand claims.
Textile PLI scheme turnover limits were halved and extended to FY 2033-34, offering long-term regulatory tailwinds.
stress_signals: 100,000 jobs lost in the diamond hub alongside US demand slumps causing factory closures [1bcd949a2599, 561255a9240b].
Textile payment dues exceeded 200 days, causing payment blockages across small traders and police-level recovery disputes [e0787797133b, 774ba602b06e, 80f44f3f370f].
Textile mills face operational margins squeeze due to power cuts and rising electricity costs [385f9b90ae46].
Labor volatility threatens production due to potential fresh agitations in textile units [d1fffb80f879].
improvement_signals: Traders successfully recovered ₹6 crore in stuck mercantile payments across major markets [a523a4bf860d].
Government reduced the Textile PLI turnover threshold by 50% and extended the timeline to FY 2033-34 [c7ee55f3effe].
Embroidery labor strike ended following a formal agreement with unit owners [3a495ae0b3ee].
what_to_watch: Working capital utilization spikes and overdues exceeding 90 days in MMF weaving and trading accounts ahead of post-festive reconciliations.
Resolution efficacy of the ₹6 crore payment recovery model across wider Surat textile trade associations.
Operational status and labor retention metrics in diamond processing MSMEs facing export order pullbacks.
